paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
heading: Amite Vengtu Ding In Pathian In Ezekiel Asep / (Eze 3.16-21)
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, na nam tate kiang ah thu gen inla, akiang uah, gam tung a namsau ka hon tutleh gam mite'n alak ua pat mi khat atelkhiak ua, galvilmi dia akoih uleh,
english: “Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and tell them, ‘When I bring the sword on a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman,

paite: ama'n gam tung a namsau hong tung amuhleh pengkul amut ding a, mipite akigalgingsak ding hi.
english: if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people,

paite: Huchi in pengkul ging za a poisaloumi kuapeuh, namsau hong tung in manloh tamahleh, asisan moh amah mah in apo ding ahi.
english: then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and doesn’t heed the warning, if the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.

paite: Pengkul ging azak a apoisak louh ziak in asisan moh akipuak mai ding ahi; ana poisakleh bel ahinna ahumbit ding ahi.
english: He heard the sound of the trumpet and didn’t take warning. His blood will be on him; whereas if he had heeded the warning, he would have delivered his soul.

paite: Himahleh galvilmi in namsau hong tung amuh a, apengkul amut louh a, mipite akigalgin louh ua, namsau ahong tun a, alak ua mi kuahiam in amanlohleh athulimlouhna in amangthang ding a, galvilmi khut ah asisan phu ka ngiat ding," chi in.
english: But if the watchman sees the sword come and doesn’t blow the trumpet, and the people aren’t warned, and the sword comes and takes any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood I will require at the watchman’s hand.’

paite: Huchibang in nang, mihing tapa, Israel inkote a dia galvilmi dia ka hon bawl na hi; huaiziak in ka kam a thupawt ngaikhia inla, ka kiang a kipan kigalginna ding thu akiang uah hilh in.
english: “So you, son of man, I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and give them warnings from me.

paite: Migilou kiang ah, "Aw migilou, si mahmah ding na hi," ka chih a, migilou a-omdan paisan ding a na hilh keileh migilou agitlouhna ah asi ding a, asisan phu bel nang a kipan ka la ding.
english: When I tell the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ and you don’t speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, but I will require his blood at your hand.

paite: Himahleh migilou a-omdan paisan ding a na hilh a, a-omdan apaisan kei laileh, agitlouhna ah asi ding a, nang bel na hinna na humbit ding hi.
english: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn’t turn from his way; he will die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your soul.

paite: Huan mihing tapa, nang Israel inkote kiang ah thu gen inla, hichibang in na chi ua, "Ka tatleknate uh leh ka khelhnate un ahon delhkhum a, huaiziak in ka thanggawp uh ahi, bangchi in ka hing nilouh thei ding ua?" na chi uhi.
heading: Mimal Mohpuakna
english: “You, son of man, tell the house of Israel: ‘You say this, “Our transgressions and our sins are on us, and we pine away in them. How then can we live?”’

paite: Kei ka hin bang in, migilou sihna ah kipahna ka nei kei a, migilou in a-omdan apaisan a ahin ka kipah lam ahi zaw. Na omdan hoih lou ua kipan kik un, kik un, Aw Israel inkote, bangziak a si ding na hi ua? chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in gen in.
english: Tell them, ‘“As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why will you die, house of Israel?”’

paite: "Nang, mihing tapa, na nam tate kiang ah gen inla, midiktat diktanna in atatlekna ni in amah ahumbit kei ding a, migilou gitlouhna in leng athulimlouhna alehngatsan ni in apuksak kei ding a, midiktat lah akhelhna ni in adiktatna in ahing thei tuan sam kei ding.
english: “You, son of man, tell the children of your people, ‘The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him in the day of his disobedience. And as for the wickedness of the wicked, he will not fall by it in the day that he turns from his wickedness; neither will he who is righteous be able to live by it in the day that he sins.

paite: Midiktat kiang ah, na hing ngeingei ding, chih ka gen in, adiktatna muang a thil ahihkhelhleh athil dik hih khat leng theihgige ahi kei ding; athilhihkhelhsa ah asi zaw ding.
english: When I tell the righteous that he will surely live, if he trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity, none of his righteous deeds will be remembered; but he will die in his iniquity that he has committed.

paite: Huan migilou kiang ah, 'Na si ngeingei ding,' ka chih nawn leuleu in, agitlouhnate alehngatsan a asiang leh adik ana hih a,
english: Again, when I say to the wicked, “You will surely die,” if he turns from his sin and does that which is lawful and right,

paite: migilou in mi koih khamnate pekik a, athilgukte apiak nawn a, hinna dante azuih a, thulimlouhna bangmah ahihkeileh ahing ngeingei ding a, asi kei ding hi.
english: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity, he will surely live. He will not die.

paite: Khelhna ana hihsa bangmah theihgige ahita kei ding a, asiang leh adik ana hihta a, ahing ngeingei ding hi.
english: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done that which is lawful and right. He will surely live.

paite: "Himahleh na nam tate'n, 'TOUPA thilhihdan akikim kei,' achih un amau hihdan adiktat kei zaw hi.
english: “‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.

paite: Midiktat in adiktatna alehngatsan a, thil gilou ana hihleh huaiziak in asi mai ding.
english: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will even die therein.

paite: Huan migilou in agitlouhna alehngatsan a, asiang leh adik ahihleh huaiziak in ahing ding.
english: When the wicked turns from his wickedness and does that which is lawful and right, he will live by it.

paite: Himahleh, 'TOUPA hihdan akikim kei,' na chi ua, aw Israel inkote michih noumau hihdan bang in vai ka hon hawmsak ding hi," achi hi.
english: Yet you say, “The way of the Lord is not fair.” House of Israel, I will judge every one of you after his ways.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, i saltan akum sawm-le-nihna, akha sawmna, huai kha ani nga ni in Jerusalem a kipan taikhia mi khat ka kiang ah ahong pai a, "Khopi zoh ahita," ahong chi hi.
heading: Jerusalem Pukna Thuthang
english: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, one who had escaped out of Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been defeated!”

paite: Huai mi taikhia ahong tun ma nitaklam in TOUPA'N ka tung ah akhut anga a; zinglam a ka kiang a hong pai in ka kam ahon kasak a, huchi in ka kam ka ka a, pau thei lou in ka om nawnta kei hi.
english: Now Yahweh’s hand had been on me in the evening, before he who had escaped came; and he had opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
heading: Mipite Khelhnate
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel gam a mun segawpsa nung a omte'n, 'Abraham khat ahi a, gam aluah a; eite bel tampi i hi ua, gam gouluah ding a piak hita ve hang,' chi in agen uhi.
english: “Son of man, those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, ‘Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many. The land is given us for inheritance.’

paite: Huaiziak in akiang uah Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: 'Sa sisan na ne ua, na milimte uh lam ah na mitte uh na lengtousak ua; sisan na suah ua, noute'n gam na tang ding uh maw?
english: Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. So should you possess the land?

paite: Na namsau uh na muang ua; thilkihhuai na hih ua; michih in invengpa zi na hihbuah ua; noute'n gam na tang ding uh maw?'
english: You stand on your sword, you work abomination, and every one of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. So should you possess the land?”’

paite: Hichibang a akiang ua na gen ding ahi, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: 'Kei ka hin bang in, mun segawpsa nung a omte namsau in apuk ngeingei ding ua, gamlak a omte sahang kiang ah nek khit dia pe ding ka hi; kulh kip leh khuk a omte hipi in asi ding uh.
english: “You shall tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “As I live, surely those who are in the waste places will fall by the sword. I will give whoever is in the open field to the animals to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of the pestilence.

paite: Gam leng ka hihsia in, mulkimhuaitak in ka bawl ding a; athilhihtheihna, akisaktheihpih abeita ding; Israel tangte asegawp ding a, kuamah avialvak nawnta kei ding uh.
english: I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment. The pride of her power will cease. The mountains of Israel will be desolate, so that no one will pass through.

paite: Thilkihhuai ahih ziak ua gam ka hihgawp a, mulkimhuaitak a ka bawl hun chiang in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.' ”
english: Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment because of all their abominations which they have committed.”’

paite: Huan nang, mihing tapa, baang bul ah kongpite ah na nam tate'n ahon ngen susup ding ua, michih in a-unaute kiang ah, "Kisa dih ua, TOUPA kiang a kipan thupawt i ngaikhe ding uh, akichi ding uh.
heading: Zawlnei Thugen Gahte
english: “As for you, son of man, the children of your people talk about you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak to one another, everyone to his brother, saying, ‘Please come and hear what the word is that comes out from Yahweh.’

paite: Huchi in ahonhon in na kiang ah ahong pai ding ua, ka mite bang mai in na ma ah ahong tu ding ua, na thu ahong ngaikhe ding ua, himahleh azui tuan kei ding uh; akam un itna thupitak ahihlang ding ua, alungtang un bel punna lam azuan ding.
english: They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goes after their gain.

paite: Ngai in, nang bel amau a ding in itna la, kilawmtak a sak leh tum bang na hi ding; na thute angaikhia ua, himahleh azui tuan kei ding uh.
english: Behold, you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they don’t do them.

paite: Hiai ahong tun hun chiang in ngai in, ahong tung lellel ahi, alak uah zawlnei a-om chih athei ding uhi, chi in," achi hi.
english: “When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”
